title: File:Hotel room bedroom in building on Chapel Street, Salford, Greater Manchester, England, on 5 October 2025.jpg
author: MatthewHoobin
description: The bedroom of an apartment hotel room operated by Pillo Rooms, in a building on Chapel Street in Salford, Greater Manchester, England, United Kingdom, on 5 October 2025. The bed has white sheets and white pillows, as well as purple pillow branded with Pillo Rooms branding,; there is a bedside table with a drawer on either side of the bed, each with a small lamp on top; the lamp on the right side of the image is on, and giving off light, while the other lamp is off. There are also rolled up towels towards the end of the bed. A table and mirror are visible against the wall to the left, and there is a window allowing some daylight into the room.
